rationale: The P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern (bound jobs with a custom timeout) is supported by measured CI workflow evidence (experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508) showing success preserved with elapsed savings. The repository has representative successful-duration history (runs complete in about 2 hours), meeting the pattern precondition. Adding a job-level timeout bound to the benchmark job bounds runaway consumption without removing any build/test step, weakening permissions, adding secrets, or introducing new network access. The matrix (all three OSes) and update-readme coverage are preserved, and fail-fast remains false because every matrix outcome is required. Stale-run cancellation is already present via concurrency, and dependency caching is not applicable because apps/10000 declares no dependencies or lockfile.
